trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This one pops on its own when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. There is nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss — just play the story. PowerPyx confirms it unlocks right after that opening mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep playing the story and this unlocks when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it pops as the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?', begins. No side work is needed, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 and this pops automatically, at the start of Chapter 3's opening mission, 'Welcome to Vice City', according to PowerPyx. Just follow the pink main-mission markers; nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 and this unlocks on its own — PowerPyx places the pop at the first two missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Story progress only, nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically once Chapter 4 is finished. Keep following the main missions; there is no extra requirement and no way to miss it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story and this gold trophy pops. It is pure story progress, so it cannot be missed — just see the campaign through to the end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission 'Breakfast Run' and this pops automatically. It is story-only, so just keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 main mission 'The Cartel Heist' and this unlocks on its own. Nothing extra is required and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission 'Child's Play' and this pops automatically. Story progress only, nothing to miss.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission 'Headliners' and this unlocks by itself. Pure story progress, impossible to miss.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission 'VCIA Takedown' and this pops automatically. Just play the story through.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 5 main mission 'Operation Savage Glory' and this unlocks on its own. It is one of the last story trophies, so it lands near the end of the campaign.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicle models, study 100 of 255 animals with binoculars, finish any 70 of 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions, and complete 300 stunts. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable, so work through it in free-roam after the story.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered around Leonida. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely, so pick the quickest ones; PowerPyx calls the under-bridge flights the fastest. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and note the 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. You can see the list under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and PowerPyx notes most of them come up naturally through the story and the 100% checklist, so this usually pops without being chased.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Push Square names two ranges — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — and notes most challenges have three difficulty tiers, with some locked until you meet their conditions. Find them on the map under Touchpad > Activities > Shooting Ranges and track progress in the same menu.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — PowerPyx counts 42 drone races across those spots, and some charge an entry fee. Check the map under Touchpad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones to see which locations you have already won at.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count, so work through the map — PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, and you can track them under Touchpad > Activities > Racing. Most spots let you hire a car, and your own car's rating can be raised with upgrades from mod shops.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', where you meet Cal, he texts you about a fishing challenge and marks a spot on the map with a purple icon. Push Square says the ask is a parrotfish over 2kg, so fish in the marked area — you will need a boat with a rod, though plenty can be borrowed nearby — until you land one big enough. Follow Cal's fishing questline to the end and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games, called 'Video Games' in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once — beating every challenge inside it is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline opens automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: she gets a call from Andy, then a text with an address in Belville. Finish all five of her quests — 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (parts 1-3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label' and 'Puff Puff Pass' — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests stay available after the story, so nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission 'Island Dreams', when he calls you and gets a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back. Push Square names the final mission 'Maritime Disputes'. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, and everything is still doable after the story.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests — 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' and 'Hometown Heroes' — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of it stays available after the story.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — but note that only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, while questlines like Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. All of them are still findable in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, 'Randy's Wish List', opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs', where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked by the green 'RK' icon in west Vice City; scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. Sports cars turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach in east Vice City, and the whole list can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty' and is only available as Jason. Purple markers point you to Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go in and destroy them as part of 'Take Out Kitty Litter'. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you the second quest, 'Spin On This', and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida. You can meditate as Jason and as Lucia at each spot, and Push Square notes a meditation only counts once its final 'zen' animation has played; track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. WARNING — possibly missable: PowerPyx reports one meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, offered after the mission 'Down to Earth' when Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen and walks to the balcony. Follow her, accept, and do it before Chapter 1 ends, because it never comes back — though it is still unconfirmed whether that one is actually required for the trophy.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break': playing as Jason, you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, 'Veteran Hunted', in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it). Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons and asks you to hunt the animals he requests and bring them back; his first quest also gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69'. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, so work through his hunts — his 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist anyway — and the trophy should come with them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, and Push Square notes 15 of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally on the way there. Track sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards; cards you sell at pawn shops still count toward your progress.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it, then hold R1 on a target). There are far more than 100 to find — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — so any 100 will do. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. You can view and track them under Progress > Challenges, where a checkmark shows which are done. Most pop naturally while you work on other trophies, and since the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, this trophy unlocks along the way — save the hardest challenges for last, or skip them entirely.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then escape the red 'heat' zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when you can call your partner (hold Right, then press Triangle). Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then break out of the search area — PowerPyx suggests a fast sports bike, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County as a spot where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. The trophy pops once you are out of the heat zone, and it also comes automatically while robbing the large bank vaults later on.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — you must stay wanted (the flashing red/blue level, not the red heat level) the whole time. This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when you can call your partner. PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs': loot a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs if you can, and keep moving. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: stand by a busy road, point it at passing traffic and scan — you do not need to drive the vehicles, scanning is enough. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch, and since the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, this trophy pops on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak points are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Eat, drink or use Adrenaline to stretch it, wear body armor, and line up a group — PowerPyx suggests the criminals at gang operations — then drop five quickly with an accurate full-auto weapon. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and your focus level grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing, so it gets easier later.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. PowerPyx points to the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1km away from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot at enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs', which unlocks jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors. Break into a store through its back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm — then find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City; the trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)', which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash with your partner (you hand off a bag to them). After that, pay the fence Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000, once you have done his Payday Loans quests) and repeat — rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so a fast motorcycle and a quick vehicle swap help you get away; all 8 vaults are needed for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', the same mission that opens bank vault robberies — tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. If you want it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs can be found in the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida. The quickest way, per PowerPyx, is to fly a plane over every black-fogged region until the whole map is visible. Story progress unfogs a good part of it on its own, so finish the campaign first and sweep up the rest in free-roam.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and while the trophy needs just one per gang, the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way there. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and you can track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar with the view in front of you and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs'. The pop is slightly delayed and fires once you are further down the street; only this specific blue Banshee counts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations — a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you can blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). You first go here during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling', and the trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can come back for the rest — it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. This is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when you can switch between both characters — check each one's level under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon). Buy a gym membership and always train with your partner alongside you (hold Right, then Triangle to call them): while one character works out, the other trains automatically, doubling your progress. Fitness clubs are marked under Map > Activities, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the game tracks the count, and you can see it by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on the notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Almost everything counts — stealthy robberies and clean escapes, incapacitating enemies, or outright violence — so it builds up passively while you chase the other trophies; if it is still short at the end, PowerPyx notes you can farm it quickly, though a violent profile makes police shoot on sight more often.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is NOT yet confirmed by any guide I read. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, with only a guess that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and the description 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something. Do not chase a specific method until a guide confirms it — check PowerPyx's guide again after more players have finished the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Late at night, after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside — the spawn is slightly random, so drive away and come back if it is not there. Follow the path from the car into the woods, where you will see the UFO's bright blue light in the sky; approach it and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside as she asks, and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is NOT yet confirmed by any guide I read. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by. That is only a guess so far, so do not grind a specific method until a guide confirms how it actually pops.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)', which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — PowerPyx says Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not one trip, and a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000, so it comes naturally with the robbery cleanup.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so those get you there fastest — PowerPyx lists 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops and 11 tattoo studios among the many stores that count. It builds up on its own across a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story-related garages do not count). They open up after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)', when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — just buy them through the app. Together they cost $160,000, so robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' then 'Register' in his garage — but buy garages first, since each one adds parking spots for registrations. At first Moses only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
